notes.title: Update v1.0.3: QOL Improvements
notes.content: [p]Thanks for playing 'Parking Together!' We've released a small update today (Version 1.0.3) that includes several Quality of Life (QOL) improvements.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improved the UI after stage selection to more clearly distinguish between "Normal" and "Challenge" modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now go directly to Challenge Mode 1-1 from the results screen after clearing stage 5-4.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor in-game text adjustments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue on stage 1-1 where an invisible collision box was present at a specific location.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]This update will be applied automatically when you restart the Steam client.[/p][p]We're constantly working to make your parking life as enjoyable as possible. If you happen to find any other issues, please feel free to let us know in the Bug Report thread on the Community Hub![/p][p]The Parking Together! Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.2: Experience improvements for some stages
notes.content:
[p]Thanks for playing 'Parking Together!'[/p][p]We've released a small update today (Version 1.0.2) with some user experience improvements for a few stages.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]What's Fixed[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]"4-2 Park of Terror":[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause the frame rate to drop.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"4-4 PARK HAZARD":[/b] Adjusted the unstable behavior of some stage mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]"5-3 TEARS OF THE PARKING":[/b] Adjusted some of the terrain to improve the player experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]The update should be applied automatically the next time you restart your Steam client.[/p][p]We're always working to make your parking life as fun as possible. If you spot any other issues, please don't hesitate to let us know in the Bug Report thread on our Community Hub![/p][p]Thanks for your support, and happy parking![/p][p][/p][p]The Parking Together! Team[/p]

notes.title: WE FINALLY RELEASED PARKING TOGETHER!
notes.content:
[h2][b]PARKING TOGETHER! is out - get ready for a chaotic Parking![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3] [b]The game is available right now on Steam at a 20% discount for a limited time, so that you can get this for a friend too![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623330/Parking_Together/" style="button"]GET PARKING TOGETHER![/url]
[/p][previewyoutube="jXQ1YMsFw5E;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]🚗 [b]Have a blast with friends in chaotic, high-stakes parking![/b]   
[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45573439/2bd35282e9c1b57ed4b175f68cbb89223cb19a45.gif"][/img]
You and your friend have one simple goal... "park" the car! But be warned... this is no ordinary parking job.
Any collision means an instant explosion! Communicate clearly and give directions to survive the heart-pounding tension![/p][h2]
🚗 [b]BUGS AND FEEDBACK [/b][/h2][p align="start"]No game is ever bug free. If you’re having issues, please write a post in the Steam forums, email us at [url="https://contact.parking_together@yaneuragames.com"]contact.parking_together@yaneuragames.com[/url] or join our [url="https://discord.gg/HQEXwgYPaZ"]Discord[/url] and report the bug in the bug reporting channel. [/p][p][/p]
